selection_rule: One development-only intervention: score-ranked clean-interictal train-only hard-negative sampling. Architecture, optimizer, five seeds, calibration grid, and temporal replay are fixed from V2.2-A.
promotion_rule: A post-development final protocol is required before blocks 5 or 6 may be opened. H2 requires fold consistency, five-seed variation, event sensitivity, FAR, parameter count, INT16 degradation, and hardware feasibility.

candidates.implementation: Same C1 inference graph: 15/47 multiscale depthwise input branches, 1x1 mixing, residual depthwise-separable 7/5/3 refinement with dilations 1/2/4. Only training sampling changes.
candidates.inference_contract: raw causal 17x1280 EEG; Conv1D, depthwise Conv1D, pointwise Conv1D, BatchNorm, ReLU, AvgPool, residual add, global average pool, linear classifier
candidates.hard_negative_contract: Exactly 0.10 unique train-only hard negatives per positive, selected from clean interictal causal endpoints outside the 30-second guard and excluding source-sampled normals; ranked by frozen source score, 30-second separation, patient-group round-robin, sampling multiplier 3.0, and source train scaler frozen. The cache fails if the full quota is unavailable.
